title: Naza (HKAFF)
synopsis:
Under the cover of night on Tel Aviv rooftops, Israeli intelligence operatives break their silence to expose the chilling mechanics behind modern warfare. Filmed in secret over three years, this unflinching investigation confronts the lethal deployment of artificial intelligence in Gaza, where black-box algorithms systematically reduce living families into cold data points. As automated surveillance turns airstrikes into an assembly line of calculated destruction, what remains of human conscience when life and death are outsourced to code?

 

Special Jury Prize, Venice International Film Festival

synopsis_lang.zh_hk:
我們習慣用人工智能簡化日常、解決問題時，有曾想過當這股力量走入戰場， 將釋放怎樣的惡魔？ 當科技奪走了最後一絲人性與同理心，戰爭竟成了演算法掌控的「流水線屠殺」。在特拉維夫燈火輝煌的大廈頂樓，24 名以色列情報官兵走入深夜鏡頭，外貌與聲音雖經隱密處理，吐露的證詞卻如刀刃般赤裸：活生生的家庭被黑箱運作的AI 簡化為報表上的冰冷數字。系統默默監視手機訊號，隨即在夜色掩護下精準空襲，將睡夢中的家庭一同抹殺。當殺戮變成螢幕上毫無溫度的點擊，人類文明剩下什麼？

 

威尼斯影展  評審團特別獎
